summary: Returns the value after checking that it is not a function.
description: Classified by its internal tag, so ordinary, `async`, generator and async-generator functions all pass. A class is a function too.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, with a function excluded from its type.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireNonFunction(null); // => null
requireNonFunction("fn"); // => "fn"
requireNonFunction(function () {}); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireNonFunction(async function () {}); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
